db:guard — pre-apply checks

  ....  env loaded from .env.local, .env
ERR: DIRECT_URL is not set, and DATABASE_URL is transaction-pooled.

db:guard (pre-apply gate) writes schema, which needs a real session. Transaction pooling hands
each statement to a different backend, so advisory locks are not held and
multi-statement DDL can half-apply — reporting success while leaving the
schema in a state nobody wrote down.

Set DIRECT_URL to the direct connection (port 5432) and run this again.
